item.title: Top Five Spin-Offs No One Asked For but We Watched Anyway
item.description: Spin-offs are funny things. Nobody requests them. Nobody campaigns for them. And yet — there they are, quietly appearing on TV schedules until you realise you’ve somehow watched an entire series. Here are five spin-offs that absolutely did not need to exist… but we still tuned in anyway. 5. Joey (2004–2006) Did anyone think Joey Tribbiani needed his own show? Apparently, yes.
